# Product Manager (early career)
Tidewell · Full-time

What you'll do

- Talk to customers every week.
- Ship with a team of four engineers.

Requirements

- 1+ years of experience shipping software products.
- Customer discovery.
- Prioritization.
- Product analytics with Amplitude.

Nice to have

- Go-to-market experience.

What we offer

- Salary range $100,000–$130,000 plus equity.
- Health, dental and vision coverage.

Tidewell is an equal opportunity employer. Fictional posting for RightStaff tests.
